The '''Wodnakki''' was a legendary creature said to have inhabited the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]]. It migrated to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon]] where it nested atop the great rock formation known as "[[The Dagger (Onderon)|The Dagger]]" and terrorized the villagers of [[Dox Piter]] with its young. The beasts were finally slain in a confrontation with [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Lina (Onderon)|Lina]] and her [[Royal Onderon Militia/Legends|Royal Guard]].

==History==
A massive, winged creature said to resemble a mutated [[Skreev]], the Wodnakki was native to [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]], the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. At some point during the reign of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Lina (Onderon)|Lina]], many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before<ref name="Codex" /> her [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> the Wodnakki migrated from Dxun to Onderon and settled on the rock spire known as "[[The Dagger (Onderon)|the Dagger]]," which was situated next to the [[Onderonian/Legends|Onderonian]] villages known as [[Dox Piter]].<ref name="Codex" />

The Wodnakki proved too difficult for the villagers to drive off, and its [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] soon began to hatch, spawning newborn creatures the size of an average [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] that began raiding the villages. When word of the Wodnakki reached Queen Lina, she gathered her [[Royal Onderon Militia/Legends|Royal Guard]] and took the fight to the Wodnakki atop the Dagger. After several [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]], the Wodnakki and its young were dead, but only Lina and her injured [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Deja Nebet]] survived, and the story of the clash became a famous Onderonian tale in the years that followed.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Wodnakki was mentioned in the Codex entry "The Dagger at Dox Piter" in the [[2019]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
